title: Analyzing performance of Retrieval Augmented Generation models for Question Answering Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.20419v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models have become almost a cornerstone of open-domain question answering tasks; in which the quality of answers generated in the process, greatly relies on the effectiveness of retrieval mechanisms. In the realm of LLM, the last two years have seen tremendous progress in RAG architectures, with many models reporting to have improved performance through various design innovations. The cultural question and answering systems of South Asia, in particular, present a specific challenge since the region is home to the vast number of languages and traditions, which are closely interrelated. Along with these deeply intertwined historical narratives increase the need for culturally grounded and context-aware interpretation. Despite major architectural advances in LLMs, claiming significant improvements, challenges remain when answering these region specific questions in native languages. In this study, we aim

translated_title: 分析检索增强生成模型在问答任务中的性能
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）模型已成为开放域问答任务的基石之一，在此类任务中，生成答案的质量在很大程度上依赖于检索机制的有效性。在大语言模型（LLM）领域，过去两年间RAG架构取得了巨大进展，许多模型通过各种设计创新报告了性能的提升。南亚地区的文化问答系统尤其面临特殊挑战，因为该地区拥有大量紧密相互关联的语言和传统，这些深度交织的历史叙事增加了对文化扎根且具备语境感知能力的解释需求。尽管大语言模型在架构上取得了声称有显著进步的改进，但在以当地母语回答该地区特定问题时仍存在挑战。在本研究中，我们旨在（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文分析了RAG模型在问答任务中的性能，指出尽管RAG架构近年取得巨大进展，但在以南亚当地语言回答该地区特有文化问题时仍面临挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes the performance of RAG models for question answering tasks, revealing that despite tremendous architectural progress, challenges persist when answering South Asian culture-specific questions in native languages.
